questions.prompt: Name a small U.S. city, town, village or borough with between 1,000 and 4,999 residents (Census Bureau 2023 estimate)
questions.note: Incorporated places (plus New England towns) with 1,000 to 4,999 residents in the Census Bureau 2023 estimates count; the state does not matter. Names that are also the name of a larger place (for example Memphis or Rome) are left out, because a player naming the famous one would be wrong.
